The Highest High Line

By: Tarryn Crossman | Delivery

Proposal


Show:

Summary:
It took 6 days and a backup team of 3 of his best friends, but eventually Tim Slab walked above the clouds. On the 22nd of September at 3200m above sea level Tim completed the highest highline walk in South Africa. He crossed 75 metres between two peaks in the Drakensberg. It took months of training to perfect the rigging of the line and the details of the climb. The team had to climb the cliff face with all their gear and then rig the line, without any other way out except by foot. They had to camp at the peak until the weather was perfect. Storms came in and ripped the line off, so that had to rerig it. But eventually the weather cleared just long enough for Tim to complete the highline.
Safety wise, there are two lines in case one breaks and then Tim is harnessed to the line. In this training video you can see what happens when he falls
https://www.instagram.com/p/BE8sSN1Q0wy/

The team filmed the entire process and are willing to share all the footage with us
